query: WITH targets AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['edutech_quizzes','quizzes','quiz_questions','edutech_quiz_questions']) AS table_name), columns AS (SELECT c.table_name,string_agg(c.column_name || ':' || c.data_type, ', ' ORDER BY c.ordinal_position) AS details FROM information_schema.columns c JOIN targets t ON t.table_name=c.table_name WHERE c.table_schema='public' GROUP BY c.table_name), counts AS (SELECT t.table_name,(xpath('/row/count/text()', query_to_xml(format('SELECT count(*) FROM public.%I',t.table_name),false,true,'')))[1]::text::bigint AS row_count FROM targets t) SELECT 'columns' AS kind,c.table_name,c.details FROM columns c UNION ALL SELECT 'count',c.table_name,c.row_count::text FROM counts c ORDER BY kind,table_name LIMIT 20;
